market_question: Will US withdraw from NATO before 2027?
reasoning: Despite campaign rhetoric, no US administration has ever formally initiated NATO withdrawal, and doing so would face overwhelming domestic and international opposition. Even a second Trump term is unlikely to overcome Congressional, military, and public resistance to trigger Article 13 by end-2026. The market's ~7.8% price overestimates this tail risk.
evidence_points: Trump’s first term included threats but never formal withdrawal steps; closest was a 2018 NYT report that he privately discussed it.
Recent Trump comments remain ambiguous and do not equate to official notice under Article 13.
NATO withdrawal would require sustained political capital and would swiftly be challenged by Congress and the courts, delaying or blocking implementation.
The 2024 election outcome is uncertain, but even a Republican administration faces steep institutional barriers.
sources_consulted: New York Times reporting on Trump's private NATO discussions (2018)
Analysis from think tanks (Brookings, CFR) on US-NATO relations
